reviewed.method: every image on labelled contact sheets of downscaled thumbnails (24 sheets, 4 x 4 tiles of 360 x 270), each sheet read twice; every candidate re-read at full size (1,400 px) before a verdict

rules.person: an identifiable person is the photograph's subject (ADR 0012)
rules.sculpture: a recent US sculpture is a subject of the photograph, not incidental (ADR 0012)
rules.mural: a recent US mural is a subject of the photograph, not incidental (ADR 0012)
rules.emblem: a government or agency logo, emblem or seal is prominent in the photograph (ADR 0012: no agency logo, emblem or seal on any page)
